parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two relatives who have type 2 diabetes.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a cake using the melting method and make a batch of scones.

text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes, suitable for serving at a party for elderly relatives.
At least three dishes must be suitable for serving cold. A balance of savoury and sweet dishes

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal that is high in non-starch polysaccharide
(NSP) / dietary fibre.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using an electric whisk and make a batch of biscuits using the creaming method.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes each to show the use of a different type of
cheese.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using pulses and make a hot dessert using fresh fruit.

text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes each to show the use of a different piece of equipment
baking tray, balloon whisk, blender, casserole dish, piping bag, rolling pin, saucepan.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two teenage girls.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using shortcrust pastry and make a cake using the creaming method.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful savoury dishes each to show the use of a different herb
or spice.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using rough puff pastry and make some small cakes or a tray bake.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two vegan friends.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a dish using yeast and make a dish using chocolate.
